NarrativeIntroText: Frostgate has fallen to the Ashen Covenant's siege engines. Take back the gatehouse control crystal and the walls will seal behind you, cutting off their reinforcements for good.
NarrativeOutroText: The gate seals with a thunderous boom. Ice spreads across the walls as a hooded figure steps from the shadows — a Cryomancer who has been sabotaging the enemy's siege engines from within. The first chapter of their advance ends here.
